profile.headline: Mobile software engineer - web / Senior front-end developer
profile.summary: Front-end engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and developing web and eLearning applications. Skilled in Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, and responsive design, with strong expertise in accessibility and user experience. Proven leader with experience managing teams, mentoring developers, and collaborating across design and engineering groups. Adept in Agile environments with a track record of delivering secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer - Web
positions.description:
• Develop web applications for the U.S. State Department’s Foreign Service Institute (FSI) using Vue.js, Pinia, and Vue Router.
• Integrate mobile content into LMS and maintain ASP.NET MVC/Web Forms applications in Azure.
• Implement responsive and accessible UIs with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Collaborate with designers and back-end engineers to translate mockups into functional, user-friendly applications.
• Analyze and recommend learning technologies to modernize mobile-to-web solutions.

positions.title: Technology Director
positions.description:
• Directed a team of 15 developers, mentoring staff and managing overseas development teams.
• Designed and developed award-winning eLearning content and responsive web applications using Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and proprietary frameworks.
• Managed Cordova iOS app development and ensured LMS compatibility (SCORM/AICC).
• Created reusable content templates and interactive learning games for enterprise clients.
• Partnered with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable front-end solutions.
